text:
Situation: Corvale East has 66 vials of imipenem and cilastatin 500 mg + 500 mg injection, providing 4 days of supply at current use. Corvale Lakeside holds 105 vials (29.8 days). Corvale General holds 472 vials (29.5 days). The product label for the NDC used at all three sites names Zambon Switzerland Ltd. in Cadempino as the manufacturing plant.

Why (FDA record): As of 2026-10-21, FDA's drug shortage list does not include imipenem and cilastatin. FDA's shortage list shows Merck Sharp & Dohme entries for imipenem and cilastatin products marked as to be discontinued, but those are separate NDCs from the one in use at our hospitals.

Our position: The NDC in use is not on the FDA shortage list and is manufactured by Zambon Switzerland Ltd. Two internal transfer options can extend Corvale East supply while keeping donor sites above two weeks. A purchase option exists with Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, which is not on the FDA shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 55 vials from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 166 vials from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director (transfer request).
3. Purchase from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC — needs buyer.

Not recommended: No action that would reduce any site below two weeks of supply.
